sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: Stop after fourteen contract rows, five controls for each of eight gates, four source dispositions, four sequential requests, and one validation sequence.

source_dispositions.adapted_mechanism: extract several claims jointly within one source version and give direct generation the same batch opportunity
source_dispositions.deferred_boundary: call reduction alone is not source-verification value and does not repeat the V641 cache mechanism
source_dispositions.falsifier: reject value when full cost, semantic parity, coverage, or matched direct-batch comparison fails

source_dispositions.adapted_mechanism: mix valid and invalid claims, permute identifiers, and inject an instruction inside source data
source_dispositions.deferred_boundary: delimiters are tested controls and do not establish isolation by construction
source_dispositions.falsifier: any untouched claim changes because another batch member or source instruction contaminates it

source_dispositions.adapted_mechanism: revise only the factor contradicted by released feedback while retaining unaffected factors
source_dispositions.deferred_boundary: the local factor update is not a reproduction of query-driven refinement or proof of continuous learning
source_dispositions.falsifier: future error fails to improve with protected coverage or sealed past predictions change

source_dispositions.adapted_mechanism: retain EBT as the selected energy-reasoning citation while exact execution checks extracted constraints
source_dispositions.deferred_boundary: energy compatibility does not certify faithful extraction and does not reopen retired energy-generation work
source_dispositions.falsifier: adopt only after a compatible local model shows independent calibration or reasoning value
